# PEP 517 build constraints for the LangGraph adapter. Generated by
# scripts/lock_requirements.sh — do not hand-edit.
#
# pip resolves a project's [build-system].requires in a FRESH isolated
# environment. Neither requirements.lock.txt nor `pip install --no-deps`
# reaches that environment: --no-deps governs runtime dependencies, and a
# constraints file passed with -c constrains only the install it is given.
# So `setuptools>=68` selected whatever setuptools had shipped that morning,
# and two identical rebuilds could differ — or one could fail — in a layer
# no lock described.
#
# pip passes PIP_CONSTRAINT through to the build environment, so the
# Dockerfile sets it to this file for the adapter install.
setuptools==84.0.0
